title: AgentMessage
description: The entire email body MUST be exactly one JSON object matching this schema. Subject line format: [POB][TASK-<id>][<intent>] <summary>. Anything else is rejected by the postmaster and dead-lettered.

idempotency_key.description: Stable per logical message. Postmaster drops duplicates. Convention: <task_id>:<intent>:<short-hash-of-body>.

task_id.description: ORG only for non-task org messages (retro, bootstrap).

thread_id.description: First message_id in the thread. Omit on thread start.

refs.description: At least one of issue/pr required for all intents except BOOTSTRAP, SYNC, INTAKE_TICKET (postmaster enforces).

body_markdown.description: Human-readable content. NEVER code (push branches instead). For INTAKE_TICKET this contains only normalizer-fenced untrusted content.

untrusted.description: True for anything originating outside the org (Discord). Postmaster wraps body in UNTRUSTED fences in the agent prompt.
